integrity: The October 2026 paper was checked at its open Question 3 and its 1/sqrt(3) positive theorem. The March 2026 paper was checked at the quantitative proposition valid below 1/sqrt(2). The new bridge is independently derived from the exact SU(2) identity, a centered Wiener-algebra logarithm estimate, outer spectral factorization, and Banach-algebra exponentiation; no numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The result proves only the lower bound tau >= 1/sqrt(2), not the exact quantitative Baxter radius. The explicit Wiener inverse factor (1-B^2)^(-2) is not asserted to be sharp, and the outerness hypothesis is retained.
title: A one-over-root-two lower bound for the quantitative Baxter radius
